To
The Tender Inviting Authority

Subject: Pre-bid queries regarding IGIDR tender IGIDR/Tender/2024/ED/09 for a ticket booking agency

Sir or Madam,

We intend to participate in the subject tender. Please clarify the points below. Each point quotes the tender text it refers to.

1. Clause 5, page 10 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The bidder should submit a copy of valid PAN and Goods and Service Tax registration (GST)."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

2. Clause 5, page 10 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The agency should have an average annual turnover of Rs. 30 Lakh for the last three consecutive financial years: FY 2020-21, FY 2021-22, and FY 2022-23."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

3. Clause 9, page 10 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "Bidders must submit documentary proof in support of meeting each of the above minimum qualification criteria."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

4. Clause 9, page 10 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "A simple undertaking by the bidder for any of the stated criteria will not suffice for the purpose."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

5. Clause 15, page 5 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The EMD paid by the successful bidder shall be held/encashed by the IGIDR as security for the execution and fulfillment of the contract."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

6. Clause 3, page 2 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The bidder has to submit an Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand only) along with the bid."
   Query: Please confirm whether an MSME or startup relaxation applies to this threshold, and which document should demonstrate it.

7. Clause 5, page 4 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The bids should be received up to the end of the day on 8th June 2024."
   Query: Please confirm that this date is unchanged by any corrigendum, and confirm the timezone.

8. Clause 7, page 4 (igidr-travel-2024.pdf).
   Tender text: "The Institute shall inform the qualified bidders of the price bid opening date."
   Query: Please confirm that this date is unchanged by any corrigendum, and confirm the timezone.

Draft for a human to review. This is not legal advice and it is not a bid recommendation from the tendering authority.

Yours faithfully,
[Authorised signatory]
[Company name]
